notes.title: Note on Release 2023
notes.notes: for some reason the release date on the steam page is set for January 2023. this is not the case and we are trying to have Steam correct this error. apologies for any confusion! Desolation Seed is in its final stages of development and is expected to be released in late winter / early spring 2023 Assuming we make it through the grueling task of turning our nightmares into interactive art.
